What is a Sanctuary

Not a vacation.
Not a course.

A Sanctuary retreat is a total immersion — into a place, into the body, into what has been waiting to surface. We choose locations that carry their own intelligence: ancient temples, living water, the silence of a rice field at dawn.

Every retreat includes 3 months of group mentorship with Ana after you return home. Because integration is not optional — it is part of the design.
